title: Claude Code Extract
description: Use Claude Code to generate clean Markdown from snapshot extractor outputs.

CLAUDECODEEXTRACT_TIMEOUT.description: Timeout for Claude Code extraction in seconds

CLAUDECODEEXTRACT_PROMPT.default: Create content.md in your output directory. Prefer readability/content.txt when it exists; otherwise read dom/output.html. Write clean Markdown for the archived page content. Stop after content.md has been written.
CLAUDECODEEXTRACT_PROMPT.description: Custom prompt for Claude Code extraction. Use this to define what Claude should extract or generate from the snapshot.

CLAUDECODEEXTRACT_MODEL.description: Claude model to use for extraction (e.g. claude-sonnet-4-6, claude-opus-4-6, claude-haiku-4-5-20251001)

CLAUDECODEEXTRACT_MAX_TURNS.description: Maximum number of agentic turns for extraction
